descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S27 Unsaved pre-round text survives a context switch and never appears in the other context's chart

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fixture patients; the Hospital patient's Pre-Round tab

When Type 'MARK-H draft T21' in the Hospital pre-round box without Save Note, switch to Nursing Home and open the resident, then switch back and reopen the Hospital chart

Then The resident's chart never shows the draft (no bleed); the Hospital chart still has it (no lost work)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: checkpoint 1 mustNotContain the draft; checkpoint 2 mustContain it. The app has src/lib/localDrafts.ts and src/lib/useAutosave.ts. If Daniela answers Q9 that an explicit unsaved-changes warning is enough, checkpoint 2 is recalibrated to accept that message.

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
